mood_contract: Awe and curiosity: the student leaves wanting the next move, not feeling tidily graduated.

intended_learnings.text: The tool that builds tools compounds: your agent runtime can generate a new agent that extends your system.
The thinking disciplines (crux, what would have to be true, pre-mortem) run at room scale through agents.
The strategy kernel, agent set and plan are grounded in your actual files, not generic advice.
Nobody knows where this ends; the next move is to keep running the loop and sharpen the answer.
